rules.titan: dense nitrogen/methane haze, warm orange/brown, no cyan main gas volumes
rules.enceladus: water-vapor and ice-particle plume mist only, no thick atmosphere

rule: Atmospheric FX must be factual per world: Titan gets dense nitrogen/methane haze with thick low-clarity amber visibility; Enceladus gets plume/ice vapor only; Mimas and Iapetus remain airless with visibility/lighting effects, not fake weather. World saturation should remain restrained.
